answer_result.answer: Dave's favorite activity is working on/restoring cars; the evidence describes car restoration as 'not just a hobby, it's a passion,' says he is 'obsessed with classic cars,' and notes that working on cars is therapeutic and relaxing for him.

evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-04, told Calvin he's been working on the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard (the restoration car he has been updating Calvin on, see above) — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential"; he said working on cars really helps him relax — "it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" — answering Calvin's question about what hobbies help him relax [S21T4].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-07-07, has arranged regular walks together with friends at a favorite park spot — he shared a photo of it: a city skyline with a river and boats in the water; they were heading there that day ("Yeah, today we are going to that spot"). He finds the peace by the river really nice [S10T3][S10T5][S10T7].
- As of 2023-11-17, found a serene spot in a nearby park (rocks and a waterfall) and photographed the waterfall there the previous week (~2023-11-10/16), sharing the pic with Calvin — Calvin: "Can't wait to check it out myself sometime" (details of the exchange in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Photography and /memories/calvin.md) [S30T13][S30T15].

- Loves music [S2T8].
- Boston music festival (the weekend before 2023-03-26, i.e., ~2023-03-18/19): found it awesome with many cool bands and an electric atmosphere, and said it reminded him why he loves music; shared a photo of a large concert crowd [S2T8].
  - Favorite band: Aerosmith — called their performance "incredible" and shared a concert photo (large eagle on stage) [S2T10].
  - "Finally saw them live" — called it an amazing experience and said "it's always a dream to see your favorites performing"; shared another "epic" photo of the band on stage (two people with guitars and a microphone) [S2T12][S2T14].
  - Did not get to hang out with the band after the show, but felt seeing them live was cool enough [S2T13][S2T14].
- His approach to creative blocks: when struggling to come up with ideas, he immerses himself in something he loves — concerts or favorite albums — which usually jumpstarts his inspiration; on 2023-05-03 he advised Calvin to do the same, take a break from music, and explore other things (and have fun doing it) [S5T11].

- On 2023-11-17, answering Calvin's question about what he likes to take photos of: being able to take good pics is key, and he loves capturing the beauty of nature — sunsets, beaches, waves — sharing one he got recently (a photo of a sunset with a wave crashing on rocks); Calvin: "Nice job, Dave! That shot looks great! Nature's so amazing!" [S30T9][S30T10]. Dave added it's incredible how much emotion and beauty nature can convey through a photo, and agreed with Calvin that nature can boost the spirits in tough times [S30T11][S30T13]; he also shared a picture he snapped the previous week (~2023-11-10/16) — a peaceful scene of a waterfall flowing over rocks and boulders — taken at a serene spot in a nearby park (Calvin: "Wow Dave, that picture is stunning! Where was that taken? It looks so serene!"; the park details in ## Parks) [S30T13][S30T14][S30T15].
- On 2023-11-17, after Calvin closed the nature-photo exchange with a photo he shot in a Japanese garden (a bench under a tree with pink flowers), Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Found an even better spot, with a bench under a tree with pink flowers - so peaceful. A perfect spot to relax and take in the beauty." — describing the same bench-under-a-pink-flower-tree scene as "a spot" he found, and Calvin: "That sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to see it." [S30T17][S30T18]; Dave then shared it — "Check it out, Calvin. It's really calming, I think you'll like it." — and the two agreed "We will definitely go there!" (a plan to visit the spot together; if it is the same Japanese-garden scene Calvin photographed, the two have found a shared favorite, though Calvin's photo is the only image attached to it so far) [S30T19].
- On 2023-10-29, told Calvin he's been getting into photography recently — he's "seen some amazing places and taken some great shots" — and offered to show Calvin them (Calvin: "Yeah, show me what you got!") [S27T2][S27T3].
- Shared two Boston photos with Calvin on 2023-10-29: first, a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower — "Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!" (Calvin: "Wow, that view looks awesome!") [S27T4][S27T5]; second, a photo of the clock tower in the city with buildings around it, which he took last month (~September 2023) — "got a great shot - it was stunning!" (Calvin: "Wow, that pic is amazing!") [S27T6].
- When Calvin recognized the clock tower ("In your last photo, is that the clock tower?"), Dave confirmed it is the clock tower — he snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning [S27T7][S27T8].
- On 2023-10-29, said photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature — "It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it." (his appreciation of nature echoes his park walks — see ## Parks; Calvin: "You're so talented, Dave!", to which Dave said "Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot.") (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S27T8].

- On 2023-10-08, caught up with Dave ("Hey Dave! What's up?"): Dave told him that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw awesome cars, got to mess with car mods, and there were so many cool machines around — "it was so much fun!" — and shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "Hey Dave, that sounds awesome! I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage." and shared a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom (see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S22T1][S22T2]. Dave: "Thanks! Yeah, this one looks great!" and said he restored and modified the car himself, adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades — it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" (shared a photo of a car driving down a street with a traffic light) [S22T3][S22T4]. Dave then said car restoration "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress" — that as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage tinkering with engines ("it was like my own sanctuary"), and he's now "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." Dave: "Thanks, Calvin. It's been my goal since I was a kid and it's awesome to be able to do something I love. Restoring things like this can be tough but the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great. Absolutely, I'm loving it." (Dave's details in the Classic cars and Hobbies and sense of purpose sections of /memories/dave.md) [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7]. Calvin: "Go for it, Dave! Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." [S22T8].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked what the toughest part of car restoration is) that it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off — echoing his earlier remarks that small details make his mod project unique and personalized (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) and that the small successes make him proud (see above) [S25T18][S25T19].
- On 2023-10-25, said working on a car project "takes me out of my head and calms me down" — complementing his long-stated "oasis of calm"/therapy remarks above [S26T4].
- As of 2023-10-29, is also getting into photography (a new hobby — details and the Boston photos he shared are in the Photography section below) [S27T2][S27T8].
